The clause provides that “[a]ny dispute, controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, or the breach, termination, or invalidity thereof shall first be referred by the parties to their senior-level executives for attempted resolution through good-faith negotiations.” Compl. 2. The Contract Arbitrator

Either party may, within the sixty (60) day period
